name: @natlang/program-inventor
description: Invent completely new natlang programs for training: an atlas of every existing idea, a new idea judged new by another model family, a program with literal instances and an exact checker built by a frontier coding agent, crisp qualification (reference replay, wrong answers, judgment ablations, keyword baselines) and a live teacher run.
